com.sun.tools.javap

类 JavapTask

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.sun.tools.javap.JavapTask
  • 所有已实现的接口:
    DisassemblerTool.DisassemblerTask, Messages, Callable<Boolean>

    public class JavapTask
extends Object
implements DisassemblerTool.DisassemblerTask, Messages
    "Main" class for javap, normally accessed from the command line via Main, or from JSR199 via DisassemblerTool.

    This is NOT part of any supported API. If you write code that depends on this, you do so at your own risk. This code and its internal interfaces are subject to change or deletion without notice.
